title: 雷射干涉位移量測~Laser-interferometric displacement metrology
focus: 外差式雷射干涉儀的條紋計數、空氣折射率補償與幾何誤差預算~Fringe counting, air-index compensation and geometric error budgets for heterodyne laser interferometers
summary: 以穩頻 HeNe 雙頻雷射與平面鏡干涉儀為對象，從每條紋 λ/4 的相位計數推到次奈米解析度，再把 Edlén 空氣折射率、死程、Abbe 與餘弦誤差、偏振洩漏的週期性非線性整合成可追溯到波長標準的位移量測不確定度預算。~Using a frequency-stabilised two-frequency HeNe laser with a plane-mirror interferometer, go from λ/4-per-fringe phase counting to sub-nanometre resolution, then fold Edlén air index, dead path, Abbe and cosine errors and polarisation-leakage periodic non-linearity into a displacement uncertainty budget traceable to the wavelength standard.

units.anchor: 量測臂、參考臂與相位計~Measurement arm, reference arm and phase meter
units.title: 光程差、條紋與相位細分~Optical-path difference, fringes and phase subdivision
units.mechanism: 雷射干涉儀把一道相干光分成參考臂與量測臂，量測臂的反射鏡隨待測物移動，兩臂重新合光後的干涉強度隨光程差作週期變化。角隅稜鏡干涉儀中位移 d 使光程差改變 2d，每移動 λ/2 走過一個條紋；平面鏡（雙程）干涉儀讓光束在量測鏡上反射兩次，光程差改變 4d，每 λ/4 一個條紋，對鏡面傾斜不敏感且解析度加倍。電子相位計把一個條紋再細分成數千等分，位移就是條紋數加上相位餘數乘以條紋週期，整個量測的長度單位來自雷射波長。~A laser interferometer splits one coherent beam into a reference arm and a measurement arm whose mirror moves with the target; after recombination the interference intensity varies periodically with the optical-path difference. In a retroreflector interferometer a displacement d changes the path by 2d, one fringe per λ/2; a plane-mirror (double-pass) interferometer reflects the beam twice from the measurement mirror, so the path changes by 4d, one fringe per λ/4, insensitive to mirror tilt and with doubled resolution. An electronic phase meter subdivides each fringe into thousands of parts, and displacement is fringe count plus phase remainder times fringe period, so the unit of length comes from the laser wavelength.
units.model: 雙程干涉儀相位 Δφ = 8πd/λ。穩頻 HeNe 真空波長 λ_vac = 632.99 nm，空氣中 n = 1.000271 時 λ_air = 632.82 nm，條紋週期 λ_air/4 = 158.2 nm；相位計細分 1024 等分時解析度 0.154 nm，4096 等分時 0.039 nm。量測 500 mm 行程要累計 0.5/158.2×10⁻⁹ ≈ 3.16×10⁶ 個條紋，計數電路一個條紋都不能漏。~Double-pass phase Δφ = 8πd/λ. A stabilised HeNe has vacuum wavelength λ_vac = 632.99 nm; in air with n = 1.000271, λ_air = 632.82 nm and the fringe period is λ_air/4 = 158.2 nm; subdividing 1024 ways gives 0.154 nm resolution and 4096 ways gives 0.039 nm. A 500 mm travel accumulates 0.5/158.2×10⁻⁹ ≈ 3.16×10⁶ fringes, and the counter may not miss a single one.
units.verify: 把量測鏡裝在壓電平台上，以已知電壓步進並用電容感測器或校正過的壓電係數對照，確認每 158.2 nm 剛好計到一個條紋、細分讀值在條紋內線性；再做往返行程，檢查歸零後的殘差是否小於一個細分單位，否則有漏計或相位計週期誤差。~Mount the measurement mirror on a piezo stage, step it with known voltages against a capacitance sensor or calibrated piezo coefficient, and confirm exactly one fringe per 158.2 nm with linear subdivision inside the fringe; then run a return trip and check that the residual after returning to zero is below one subdivision unit, otherwise fringes are lost or the phase meter has periodic error.
units.failure: 光束被遮斷或訊號強度瞬間低於門檻時計數器掉一個或多個條紋，之後所有讀值都偏移 158.2 nm 的整數倍且無法事後修正；在機台校正中這會表現為突然出現的台階狀誤差。~A beam interruption or a momentary drop of signal strength below threshold makes the counter lose one or more fringes, after which every reading is offset by an integer multiple of 158.2 nm with no possibility of later correction; in machine calibration this appears as a sudden step in the error plot.
units.misconception: 平面鏡干涉儀每 λ/2 給一個條紋，和角隅稜鏡干涉儀一樣。~A plane-mirror interferometer gives one fringe per λ/2 just like a retroreflector interferometer.

units.anchor: 雙頻雷射與都卜勒拍頻~Two-frequency laser and Doppler beat
units.title: 外差偵測、都卜勒頻移與速度上限~Heterodyne detection, Doppler shift and the velocity limit
units.mechanism: 外差式干涉儀的雷射輸出兩個頻率相差 f_s 的正交偏振分量，一個進參考臂、一個進量測臂；光電偵測器看到的是 f_s 的拍頻訊號，位移資訊藏在這個拍頻相對於參考拍頻的相位差中。鏡子移動時量測光束帶都卜勒頻移，拍頻變成 f_s ± 4v/λ；相位用交流訊號量測，對雷射強度漂移與偵測器偏壓不敏感，這是外差優於零差（直流）方案的關鍵。但拍頻不能降到零或翻轉，所以分頻 f_s 直接決定可量測的最高速度。~A heterodyne interferometer's laser emits two orthogonally polarised components separated by f_s; one goes to the reference arm, the other to the measurement arm, and the photodetector sees a beat at f_s whose phase relative to a reference beat carries the displacement. A moving mirror Doppler-shifts the measurement beam so the beat becomes f_s ± 4v/λ; because phase is read on an ac signal it is immune to laser-intensity drift and detector offset, the key advantage over homodyne (dc) schemes. The beat may not fall to zero or reverse, so the split frequency f_s directly sets the maximum measurable velocity.
units.model: 雙程干涉儀的都卜勒頻移為 4v/λ：v = 1 m/s 時 4/632.8×10⁻⁹ ≈ 6.32 MHz。速度上限 v_max = f_s·λ/4：聲光調制分頻 f_s = 20 MHz 時 v_max ≈ 3.16 m/s；Zeeman 分頻 2 MHz 時只有 0.32 m/s。相位計若每 10 µs 更新一次，在 1 m/s 下每次更新之間移動 10 µm，約 63 個條紋，計數器必須以遠高於拍頻的時脈運作。~Double-pass Doppler shift is 4v/λ: at v = 1 m/s it is 4/632.8×10⁻⁹ ≈ 6.32 MHz. Velocity limit v_max = f_s·λ/4: with an acousto-optic split f_s = 20 MHz, v_max ≈ 3.16 m/s; a 2 MHz Zeeman split allows only 0.32 m/s. If the phase meter updates every 10 µs, at 1 m/s the mirror moves 10 µm between updates, about 63 fringes, so the counter clock must run far above the beat frequency.
units.verify: 用示波器或頻譜儀同時看參考拍頻與量測拍頻：靜止時兩者頻率相同，鏡子以定速移動時量測拍頻應偏移 4v/λ，由偏移量反算速度並與平台編碼器比較；逐步提高速度直到讀值跳動，確認失效點與 f_s·λ/4 一致。~Watch the reference and measurement beats together on an oscilloscope or spectrum analyser: at rest they coincide, and with the mirror moving at constant speed the measurement beat should shift by 4v/λ; back out velocity from the shift and compare with the stage encoder, then raise speed until readings break up and confirm the failure point matches f_s·λ/4.
units.failure: 平台在急停或振動時瞬間超過速度上限，拍頻穿過零而相位計失去方向資訊，之後位移讀值以錯誤方向累積；系統看似正常運作，直到與編碼器對比才發現幾十微米的偏差。~A stage that momentarily exceeds the velocity limit during a hard stop or vibration drives the beat through zero, the phase meter loses direction information and displacement accumulates with the wrong sign; the system appears normal until a comparison with the encoder reveals tens of micrometres of discrepancy.
units.misconception: 外差式干涉儀的解析度由分頻 f_s 決定，f_s 越高解析度越好。~Heterodyne resolution is set by the split frequency f_s, so higher f_s means finer resolution.

units.anchor: 穩頻 HeNe 雷射頭~Frequency-stabilised HeNe laser head
units.title: 波長穩定性、雙頻產生與溯源~Wavelength stability, two-frequency generation and traceability
units.mechanism: 位移的尺就是波長，所以雷射頭必須把頻率鎖住：常見作法是讓 HeNe 管內兩個正交偏振縱模的強度相等以鎖定腔長，或以 Zeeman 效應在軸向磁場中產生相差約 2 MHz 的左右旋圓偏振模態；需要更高速度時改用單頻雷射配聲光調制器移頻 20 MHz 以上。波長值由製造商對照碘穩頻 HeNe（CIPM 建議的 632.99 nm 參考）校正，商用雷射頭的波長準確度與長期穩定度通常在 10⁻⁸ 到 10⁻⁷ 量級，開機後需要數十分鐘熱平衡。~The ruler is the wavelength, so the laser head must lock its frequency: common schemes balance the intensities of two orthogonally polarised longitudinal modes of the HeNe tube to lock cavity length, or use the Zeeman effect in an axial magnetic field to create left- and right-circular modes about 2 MHz apart; for higher speeds a single-frequency laser is shifted by 20 MHz or more with an acousto-optic modulator. The wavelength value is calibrated by the manufacturer against an iodine-stabilised HeNe, the 632.99 nm reference recommended by the CIPM, and commercial heads reach wavelength accuracy and long-term stability of order 10⁻⁸ to 10⁻⁷ after tens of minutes of thermal settling.
units.model: 波長相對誤差直接變成長度相對誤差：Δλ/λ = 1×10⁻⁸ 時，1 m 行程的誤差為 10 nm，0.1 m 時 1 nm；若暖機不足使波長漂移 1×10⁻⁷，1 m 行程誤差升到 100 nm。相較之下 1 K 的空氣溫度誤差造成約 930 nm/m，所以波長穩定度在整體預算中通常只占小項，但它是整條溯源鏈的根。~Fractional wavelength error maps directly into fractional length error: at Δλ/λ = 1×10⁻⁸ a 1 m travel errs by 10 nm and 0.1 m by 1 nm; an under-warmed head drifting by 1×10⁻⁷ raises the 1 m error to 100 nm. By comparison a 1 K air-temperature error costs about 930 nm/m, so wavelength stability is usually a minor budget item, but it is the root of the whole traceability chain.
units.verify: 把雷射頭與碘穩頻參考雷射或經校正的波長計做拍頻比對，記錄開機後 0 到 60 分鐘的頻率漂移曲線，確定可用的暖機時間；每年或在懷疑漂移時重做並把波長值與不確定度寫進校正證書，溯源到國家計量機構的波長標準。~Beat the head against an iodine-stabilised reference laser or a calibrated wavemeter, log the frequency drift from 0 to 60 minutes after switch-on to fix the usable warm-up time, repeat yearly or whenever drift is suspected, and record the wavelength value and uncertainty in the calibration certificate traceable to the national metrology institute's wavelength standard.
units.failure: 雷射管老化使增益下降，穩頻迴路在兩模態強度無法平衡時跳到鄰近縱模，波長瞬間改變約 10⁻⁶，正在進行的長行程校正出現微米級台階且不可追溯。~An ageing tube with falling gain lets the stabilisation loop, unable to balance the two mode intensities, hop to an adjacent longitudinal mode; the wavelength changes by about 10⁻⁶ at once and a long-travel calibration in progress acquires a micrometre step that cannot be traced.
units.misconception: HeNe 雷射的波長是物理常數，任何 HeNe 都可以當作長度標準。~The HeNe wavelength is a physical constant, so any HeNe can serve as a length standard.

units.anchor: 偏振分光鏡、波片與平面鏡光學~Polarising beamsplitter, waveplates and plane-mirror optics
units.title: 干涉光學元件與週期性非線性~Interferometer optics and periodic non-linearity
units.mechanism: 偏振分光鏡依偏振把兩個頻率分到參考臂與量測臂，四分之一波片讓每次往返的偏振旋轉 90°，使光束在平面鏡干涉儀中走完第二程後才離開；角隅稜鏡則靠三面正交反射把光原路送回。任何偏振洩漏——分光鏡消光比不足、波片相位誤差、鏡面應力雙折射或雷射兩頻率的偏振不正交——都會讓一部分參考頻率混進量測臂，拍頻相位出現隨位移週期變化的誤差，週期等於一個條紋，這就是外差干涉儀的週期性非線性，無法靠平均消除。~The polarising beamsplitter routes the two frequencies by polarisation into reference and measurement arms; quarter-wave plates rotate the polarisation by 90° on each round trip so that in a plane-mirror interferometer the beam leaves only after its second pass, while a corner cube returns the beam along its path through three orthogonal reflections. Any polarisation leakage, from limited beamsplitter extinction, waveplate retardance error, stress birefringence in the optics or imperfect orthogonality of the laser's two frequencies, mixes some reference frequency into the measurement arm; the beat phase then carries an error that cycles once per fringe with displacement, the periodic non-linearity of heterodyne interferometers, which averaging cannot remove.
units.model: 一階週期性非線性的幅度約為 (λ/4)/(2π)·β，β 為洩漏場與主場的振幅比。偏振分光鏡強度消光比 1:1000 時 β = √0.001 = 0.032，非線性幅度 ≈ 158.2/(2π)×0.032 ≈ 0.8 nm；消光比只有 1:100 時 β = 0.1，非線性升到 ≈ 2.5 nm，已超過許多奈米級平台的定位規格。~The first-order periodic non-linearity has amplitude about (λ/4)/(2π)·β, with β the amplitude ratio of leaked to main field. For a beamsplitter intensity extinction of 1:1000, β = √0.001 = 0.032 and the amplitude is ≈ 158.2/(2π)×0.032 ≈ 0.8 nm; at only 1:100, β = 0.1 and the non-linearity rises to ≈ 2.5 nm, beyond the positioning specification of many nanometre-class stages.
units.verify: 讓量測鏡以壓電做慢速、平滑的掃描，同時以電容感測器量真實位移，把干涉儀讀值減去擬合直線後作頻譜分析，在每條紋一次與兩次的空間頻率處讀出非線性幅度；旋轉雷射頭或波片微調偏振對準，看幅度是否降到最低，並記錄最終值進入預算。~Scan the measurement mirror slowly and smoothly with a piezo while a capacitance sensor records true displacement, subtract a fitted line from the interferometer reading and Fourier-analyse the residual, reading the non-linearity amplitude at once and twice per fringe; fine-rotate the laser head or waveplates to minimise it and record the final value in the budget.
units.failure: 用普通膠合而非光學接觸的分光鏡在溫度變化下出現應力雙折射，消光比從 1:1000 退化到 1:100，非線性從 0.8 nm 漲到 2.5 nm，奈米定位平台的閉迴路控制跟著這個假訊號擺動，表現為每 158 nm 重複一次的位置紋波。~A cemented rather than optically contacted beamsplitter develops stress birefringence with temperature, extinction degrades from 1:1000 to 1:100, the non-linearity grows from 0.8 nm to 2.5 nm, and a nanopositioning stage's closed loop follows this false signal, showing a position ripple repeating every 158 nm.
units.misconception: 週期性非線性是隨機雜訊，多次平均就能消除。~Periodic non-linearity is random noise that averaging removes.

units.anchor: 環境感測器與 Edlén 補償~Environmental sensors and Edlén compensation
units.title: 空氣折射率、Edlén 公式與死程誤差~Air refractive index, the Edlén equation and dead-path error
units.mechanism: 干涉儀量的是空氣中的波長數，長度 = 條紋數×λ_vac/(4n)，因此空氣折射率 n 必須即時已知。n − 1 在標準狀態約 2.7×10⁻⁴，隨溫度、壓力、濕度與二氧化碳變化，Edlén 公式及其修正版（Birch–Downs、Bönsch–Potulski）或 Ciddor 公式用這些量算出 n，NIST 的工程計量工具箱提供公開的線上計算。死程是干涉儀歸零時量測鏡與分光鏡之間已存在的距離：歸零後若 n 改變，這段未被計數的光程也會跟著變，造成與位移無關的讀值偏移，必須以死程長度另外補償。~The interferometer counts wavelengths in air, so length = fringes×λ_vac/(4n) and the air index n must be known in real time. At standard conditions n − 1 is about 2.7×10⁻⁴ and varies with temperature, pressure, humidity and carbon dioxide; the Edlén equation and its revisions (Birch–Downs, Bönsch–Potulski) or the Ciddor equation compute n from those quantities, and the NIST Engineering Metrology Toolbox offers a public online calculator. Dead path is the distance already present between beamsplitter and measurement mirror when the counter is zeroed: if n changes afterwards, that uncounted path changes too and produces a reading offset unrelated to displacement, which must be compensated separately from the dead-path length.
units.model: 近似靈敏度：∂n/∂T ≈ −0.93 ppm/K、∂n/∂P ≈ +0.27 ppm/hPa、∂n/∂RH ≈ −0.0085 ppm/%RH。1 m 行程上，1 K 誤差 → 930 nm，1 hPa → 270 nm，10 %RH → 85 nm。感測器不確定度 0.1 K、0.1 hPa、2 %RH 時合成 √(93² + 27² + 17²) ≈ 98 nm/m ≈ 0.1 ppm。死程 100 mm 在歸零後溫度變 1 K（Δn ≈ 1 ppm）時產生 100 nm 偏移，即使平台完全沒動。~Approximate sensitivities: ∂n/∂T ≈ −0.93 ppm/K, ∂n/∂P ≈ +0.27 ppm/hPa, ∂n/∂RH ≈ −0.0085 ppm/%RH. Over 1 m, a 1 K error → 930 nm, 1 hPa → 270 nm, 10 %RH → 85 nm. With sensor uncertainties of 0.1 K, 0.1 hPa and 2 %RH the combination is √(93² + 27² + 17²) ≈ 98 nm/m ≈ 0.1 ppm. A 100 mm dead path with a 1 K change after zeroing (Δn ≈ 1 ppm) produces a 100 nm offset even though the stage has not moved.
units.verify: 把參考臂與量測臂都固定，只改變房間溫度或打開空調，記錄讀值漂移並與死程×Δn 的預測比較，可同時驗證死程設定與折射率補償；再以 NIST 線上計算器交叉核對補償器輸出的 n，Edlén 與 Ciddor 兩式在常規條件下差異應小於 1×10⁻⁸。~With both arms fixed, change only the room temperature or toggle the air conditioning, log the reading drift and compare with dead path×Δn to verify both the dead-path setting and the index compensation; cross-check the compensator's n against the NIST online calculator, where Edlén and Ciddor should agree to better than 1×10⁻⁸ under ordinary conditions.
units.failure: 溫度感測器放在機台外殼而不是光束路徑旁，空調循環造成光路與感測器之間 0.5 K 的差異，每公尺出現 470 nm 的週期性誤差，被誤判為機台導軌誤差而反覆修機。~A temperature sensor placed on the machine casing rather than beside the beam path sees a 0.5 K difference from the light path under air-conditioning cycles, producing a 470 nm per metre periodic error that is misread as guideway error and triggers repeated mechanical rework.
units.misconception: 只要實驗室溫控在 ±1 °C，干涉儀就不需要折射率補償。~With the laboratory held to ±1 °C the interferometer needs no index compensation.

units.anchor: Abbe 偏距與光束對準~Abbe offset and beam alignment
units.title: Abbe 誤差、餘弦誤差與幾何誤差預算~Abbe error, cosine error and the geometric error budget
units.mechanism: 干涉儀的光束就是量測線，Abbe 原則要求它與被測位移共線；若量測線與功能點之間有偏距 h，平台的俯仰或偏擺角 θ 會造成 h·θ 的一階誤差，而且不隨平台改善而消失。光束與運動軸之間的夾角 θ 則造成餘弦誤差 L(1 − cosθ) ≈ Lθ²/2，是二階但隨行程線性放大。平面鏡干涉儀還要加上量測鏡的平面度：平台側向移動時光束落在鏡面不同位置，鏡面起伏直接變成讀值。這些幾何項通常比干涉儀本身的解析度大兩到三個數量級，是預算的主體。~The interferometer beam is the measuring line, and the Abbe principle requires it to be collinear with the displacement being measured; with an offset h between the measuring line and the functional point, stage pitch or yaw θ produces a first-order error h·θ that does not shrink as the stage improves. An angle θ between beam and motion axis gives the cosine error L(1 − cosθ) ≈ Lθ²/2, second order but growing linearly with travel. A plane-mirror interferometer adds mirror flatness: as the stage moves laterally the beam lands on different parts of the mirror and the surface figure enters the reading directly. These geometric terms are typically two to three orders larger than the interferometer's own resolution and dominate the budget.
units.model: Abbe 誤差 = h·θ：h = 50 mm、俯仰 10 arcsec = 48.5 µrad 時誤差 2.4 µm。餘弦誤差 = Lθ²/2：L = 1 m、θ = 1 mrad 時 0.5 µm；對準到 0.1 mrad 則降為 5 nm。平面鏡平面度 λ/10 = 63 nm 的峰谷值在側向行程中直接出現在讀值裡。鋁製夾具 200 mm 在 0.5 K 溫差下伸長 23×10⁻⁶×0.2×0.5 = 2.3 µm，說明機械熱漂移同樣必須列入。~Abbe error = h·θ: with h = 50 mm and 10 arcsec = 48.5 µrad of pitch the error is 2.4 µm. Cosine error = Lθ²/2: at L = 1 m and θ = 1 mrad it is 0.5 µm, falling to 5 nm when aligned to 0.1 mrad. A plane mirror with λ/10 = 63 nm peak-to-valley flatness puts that figure directly into the reading during lateral travel. An aluminium fixture of 200 mm under a 0.5 K gradient grows by 23×10⁻⁶×0.2×0.5 = 2.3 µm, showing that mechanical thermal drift belongs in the same budget.
units.verify: 用自準直儀或電子水平儀量平台全行程的俯仰與偏擺，乘以實測的 Abbe 偏距得到誤差曲線；以光束走離法（在遠端用十字標靶觀察光斑位移）把餘弦角對準到 0.1 mrad 以下；平面鏡以干涉儀量平面度並在補償表中扣除；最後把干涉儀與另一條獨立量測線（例如第二台干涉儀或步距規）比較，殘差應在預算內。~Measure stage pitch and yaw over the full travel with an autocollimator or electronic level and multiply by the measured Abbe offset to get the error curve; align the cosine angle below 0.1 mrad by beam walk-off, watching spot displacement on a far target; measure the plane mirror's flatness interferometrically and subtract it in the compensation map; finally compare the interferometer with an independent measuring line such as a second interferometer or a step gauge, and the residual should fit the budget.
units.failure: 為了方便安裝把角隅稜鏡放在工作台側邊 100 mm 處，平台偏擺 5 arcsec 就產生 2.4 µm 誤差，整套次奈米解析度的干涉儀輸出微米級的錯誤，而且在重複性測試中看不出來，因為偏擺是可重複的。~Placing the retroreflector 100 mm beside the worktable for convenience lets 5 arcsec of stage yaw produce 2.4 µm of error; a sub-nanometre-resolution interferometer then reports micrometre-level mistakes that repeatability tests never reveal, because the yaw is repeatable.
units.misconception: 干涉儀解析度 0.1 nm，所以量測不確定度也在奈米等級。~With 0.1 nm resolution the measurement uncertainty is also at the nanometre level.

units.anchor: 多軸光路、延遲與同步觸發~Multi-axis optics, latency and synchronous trigger
units.title: 平台與機台整合：多軸、延遲與訊號同步~Stage and machine integration: multi-axis, latency and synchronisation
units.mechanism: 在晶圓台或精密機台上，一支雷射頭透過分光器供應多條量測軸，每軸有自己的干涉儀、接收器與相位計，所有軸的資料必須在同一時刻取樣，否則平台在運動中各軸讀值對應不同位置。干涉儀訊號到控制器的延遲乘以速度就是位置錯誤，所以高速平台要求確定性的延遲與硬體觸發。光纖傳輸雷射雖然避免雷射頭的熱源靠近平台，但保偏光纖的偏振串擾會增加週期性非線性；光束在長行程上的走離、強度下降與空氣擾動也要在整合階段用擋風罩與短光路處理。~On a wafer stage or precision machine one laser head feeds several measurement axes through beamsplitters, each with its own interferometer, receiver and phase meter, and all axes must be sampled at the same instant or a moving stage yields readings from different positions per axis. Signal latency from interferometer to controller times velocity is position error, so fast stages demand deterministic latency and hardware triggering. Fibre delivery keeps the laser's heat away from the stage but polarisation cross-talk in polarisation-maintaining fibre raises periodic non-linearity; beam walk-off over long travel, falling signal strength and air turbulence are handled at integration with shrouds and short paths.
units.model: 延遲誤差 = v·t_latency：v = 1 m/s、延遲 1 µs → 1 µm；要把它壓到 10 nm，延遲必須小於 10 ns 或由控制器用速度外推補償。兩軸取樣時間差 100 ns 在 0.5 m/s 下造成 50 nm 的軸間位置錯配。光束走離：量測鏡傾斜 50 µrad、雙程光路 1 m，回光橫向偏移 2×50×10⁻⁶×1 = 100 µm，對 6 mm 光束直徑仍可接受，但 500 µrad 就會造成接收器訊號衰減。~Latency error = v·t_latency: at v = 1 m/s a 1 µs latency gives 1 µm; holding it to 10 nm needs latency below 10 ns or velocity-based extrapolation in the controller. A 100 ns sampling skew between two axes at 0.5 m/s mismatches them by 50 nm. Beam walk-off: a 50 µrad mirror tilt over a 1 m double-pass path shifts the return beam laterally by 2×50×10⁻⁶×1 = 100 µm, acceptable for a 6 mm beam, but 500 µrad would already starve the receiver.
units.verify: 用同一個硬體觸發同時鎖存所有軸與平台編碼器的讀值，在定速運動中比較各軸的時間戳與位置差，推算延遲與取樣時間差；以已知的延遲補償參數重做並確認殘差小於 10 nm；全行程記錄每個接收器的訊號強度與光斑位置，列出強度低於門檻 50% 以前的安全行程範圍。~Latch all axes and the stage encoder with one hardware trigger, compare time stamps and position differences between axes during constant-velocity motion to derive latency and sampling skew, repeat with the known latency compensation and confirm residuals below 10 nm; record every receiver's signal strength and spot position over full travel and document the safe travel range before strength falls below 50% of threshold.
units.failure: 各軸相位計各自以軟體輪詢取樣，取樣時間差隨作業系統負載在數微秒之間抖動，兩軸合成的二維軌跡在高速下出現幾百奈米的隨機扭曲，被誤認為平台的機械共振。~Phase meters polled separately in software have sampling skew that jitters by microseconds with operating-system load; the two-axis trajectory then shows hundreds of nanometres of random distortion at high speed that is mistaken for mechanical stage resonance.
units.misconception: 干涉儀是光學量測，所以沒有電子延遲問題。~An interferometer is an optical measurement, so electronic latency is not an issue.

units.anchor: 步距規比對與不確定度預算表~Step-gauge comparison and uncertainty-budget table
units.title: 溯源驗證、比對測試與工程交接~Traceability validation, comparison tests and engineering handoff
units.mechanism: 整合後的驗證不是再量一次解析度，而是把整條鏈與獨立的、溯源到國家標準的實體標準比對：以校正過的步距規或量塊組在全行程上做雙向重複量測，依 ISO 230-2 的方式分出系統誤差、反向差與重複性；另一種方法是反轉測試，把干涉儀與量測鏡對調位置，幾何誤差換號而干涉儀誤差不變，兩者可分離。所有量測不確定度依 GUM 列成預算表，包含波長、折射率、死程、Abbe、餘弦、非線性、解析度與實體標準本身的熱膨脹，交接文件還要寫明對準程序、暖機時間與環境感測器位置。~Post-integration validation does not re-measure resolution; it compares the whole chain with an independent physical standard traceable to the national institute: a calibrated step gauge or gauge-block set measured bidirectionally over full travel, separating systematic error, reversal error and repeatability in the manner of ISO 230-2. A reversal test, swapping interferometer and mirror positions so that geometric errors change sign while interferometer errors do not, separates the two. All uncertainties are tabulated per GUM, covering wavelength, air index, dead path, Abbe, cosine, non-linearity, resolution and the thermal expansion of the physical standard itself, and the handoff document states alignment procedure, warm-up time and sensor placement.
units.model: 500 mm 行程的預算（教學假設，皆為標準不確定度）：波長 1×10⁻⁸×0.5 m = 5 nm；折射率補償 0.1 ppm → 50 nm；死程 50 mm×0.3 ppm = 15 nm；Abbe 20 mm×5 arcsec = 485 nm；餘弦 0.3 mrad → 22.5 nm；非線性 0.8 nm；解析度 0.15 nm。RSS = 488 nm，k = 2 擴展不確定度 ≈ 0.98 µm，其中 Abbe 一項占 99%。鋼製步距規 500 mm、溫度不確定度 0.1 K 又貢獻 11.5 ppm/K×0.5×0.1 = 575 nm，比對時必須量工件溫度。~Budget for 500 mm travel (teaching assumptions, all standard uncertainties): wavelength 1×10⁻⁸×0.5 m = 5 nm; index compensation 0.1 ppm → 50 nm; dead path 50 mm×0.3 ppm = 15 nm; Abbe 20 mm×5 arcsec = 485 nm; cosine 0.3 mrad → 22.5 nm; non-linearity 0.8 nm; resolution 0.15 nm. RSS = 488 nm, expanded uncertainty at k = 2 ≈ 0.98 µm, with the Abbe term taking 99%. A 500 mm steel step gauge with 0.1 K temperature uncertainty adds 11.5 ppm/K×0.5×0.1 = 575 nm, so the artefact temperature must be measured during comparison.
units.verify: 在全行程取至少 10 個目標位置、每位置雙向各 5 次，計算每點的平均偏差與標準差，與步距規證書值相減後畫出誤差曲線；若曲線斜率對應的 ppm 值超過折射率預算，先懷疑溫度感測；做反轉測試分離幾何項；最後確認每一項實測值都落在預算表內，簽署交接。~Take at least 10 target positions over full travel with 5 bidirectional repeats each, compute mean deviation and standard deviation per point, subtract the step-gauge certificate values and plot the error curve; if the curve's slope in ppm exceeds the index budget, suspect temperature sensing first; run the reversal test to separate geometric terms; finally confirm every measured term lies within the budget table and sign the handoff.
units.failure: 交接時只給出「解析度 0.1 nm、準確度 0.5 ppm」而沒有預算表與對準程序，使用者把角隅稜鏡換到不同偏距的位置，Abbe 誤差翻倍而無人察覺，產品公差連續超差數週才追溯到量測系統。~A handoff that states only resolution 0.1 nm and accuracy 0.5 ppm without the budget table and alignment procedure lets the user move the retroreflector to a different offset; the Abbe error doubles unnoticed and product tolerances are violated for weeks before the measuring system is suspected.
units.misconception: 干涉儀直接溯源到波長，所以不需要再和實體標準比對。~An interferometer is traceable to the wavelength, so comparison with a physical standard is unnecessary.

example: 位移量測預算練習：平面鏡外差干涉儀量 500 mm 平台，λ_vac = 632.99 nm，空氣 n = 1.000271，λ_air = 632.82 nm，條紋週期 λ_air/4 = 158.2 nm，全行程 3.16×10⁶ 個條紋，1024 細分給 0.154 nm 解析度。環境感測器不確定度 0.1 K、0.1 hPa、2 %RH，折射率不確定度 √(0.093² + 0.027² + 0.017²) ≈ 0.098 ppm，對 500 mm 為 49 nm；死程 50 mm 在 0.3 ppm 變化下 15 nm；Abbe 偏距 20 mm、俯仰 5 arcsec（24.2 µrad）給 485 nm；餘弦角 0.3 mrad 給 0.5×(0.3×10⁻³)²/2 = 22.5 nm；波長 1×10⁻⁸ 給 5 nm；非線性 0.8 nm。RSS ≈ 488 nm，k = 2 約 0.98 µm。若把 Abbe 偏距改到 2 mm，該項降為 48.5 nm，RSS 降到 ≈ 74 nm，k = 2 ≈ 0.15 µm，改善超過 6 倍，而干涉儀本身一項都沒變。數值為教學假設，不代表任何產品規格。~Displacement-budget exercise: a plane-mirror heterodyne interferometer on a 500 mm stage, λ_vac = 632.99 nm, air n = 1.000271, λ_air = 632.82 nm, fringe period λ_air/4 = 158.2 nm, 3.16×10⁶ fringes over full travel, 1024 subdivisions giving 0.154 nm resolution. Sensor uncertainties of 0.1 K, 0.1 hPa and 2 %RH give an index uncertainty √(0.093² + 0.027² + 0.017²) ≈ 0.098 ppm, 49 nm over 500 mm; a 50 mm dead path under 0.3 ppm change gives 15 nm; a 20 mm Abbe offset with 5 arcsec (24.2 µrad) pitch gives 485 nm; a 0.3 mrad cosine angle gives 0.5×(0.3×10⁻³)²/2 = 22.5 nm; wavelength at 1×10⁻⁸ gives 5 nm; non-linearity 0.8 nm. RSS ≈ 488 nm, k = 2 about 0.98 µm. Reducing the Abbe offset to 2 mm drops that term to 48.5 nm, the RSS to ≈ 74 nm and k = 2 to ≈ 0.15 µm, a better than sixfold improvement without touching the interferometer itself. Values are teaching assumptions, not any product's specification.
history: Michelson 在 1890 年代以干涉儀用鎘紅線定義公尺，奠定以波長作長度單位的思路；1960 年公尺改以 Kr-86 波長定義，同年 HeNe 雷射問世，1970 年代 Hewlett-Packard 推出以 Zeeman 雙頻 HeNe 為核心的商用外差式干涉儀，使機台校正與晶圓台定位得以追溯到波長。1983 年公尺改由光速定義後，碘穩頻 HeNe 的 632.99 nm 成為 CIPM 建議的實現方式，Edlén 公式及其修正版與 Ciddor 公式則提供空氣折射率的公開計算基礎，今日 NIST 仍以線上工具箱公開提供。本課只重建公開原理，不涉及任何廠商的專有訊號處理。~Michelson used an interferometer in the 1890s to express the metre in cadmium red-line wavelengths, establishing the wavelength as a unit of length; in 1960 the metre was redefined by the Kr-86 wavelength, the same year the HeNe laser appeared, and in the 1970s Hewlett-Packard introduced commercial heterodyne interferometers built on Zeeman two-frequency HeNe lasers, making machine calibration and wafer-stage positioning traceable to the wavelength. After the 1983 speed-of-light definition of the metre, the iodine-stabilised HeNe at 632.99 nm became a CIPM-recommended realisation, while the Edlén equation with its revisions and the Ciddor equation gave a public basis for air-index computation, still offered online by NIST today. This course reconstructs public principles only, not any vendor's proprietary signal processing.
